subject: physics

hotspots.label: Force Arrows
hotspots.description: Two arrows meeting at the box — each is a push or pull with a size in newtons and a direction.
hotspots.positionHint: Left and right arrow beams touching the box sides.
hotspots.function: Represents each applied force with length = newtons and heading = direction.

hotspots.label: Object
hotspots.description: The box all the forces act on — it moves only when the forces stop cancelling.
hotspots.positionHint: A smooth wooden box at center.
hotspots.function: The target object whose motion the net force controls.

hotspots.label: Net Force Arrow
hotspots.description: The leftover arrow after the two pushes combine — zero N when balanced, or a single strong arrow when they aren't.
hotspots.positionHint: A third arrow floating above the box, appearing on Go.
hotspots.function: Shows the combined net force in newtons and its direction.

hotspots.label: Newton Scale
hotspots.description: The plate reading each pull, in newtons (N), the SI unit for force.
hotspots.positionHint: A small scale plate on a post to the side.
hotspots.function: Measures and displays force magnitude in newtons.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper background, soft vignette, no floor grid. Warm wooden box on a neutral mat, two coral/blue force arrows of adjustable length, floating green net arrow, small newton scale. Saturated color only on arrows and dots. Neutral studio light, no bloom, no emissive.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0. Box: warm oak (roughness ~0.5, thin grain). Arrows: matte saturated prisms (roughness ~0.4). Scale: paper face with ink digits. Slider handles warm-grey. Readout labels runtime overlay.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: forces as arrows in newtons, balanced vs. unbalanced, on a wooden box.

GEOMETRY: box at origin on a soft mat (1.2×1.2 footprint, height .35). Left and right arrow beams from either side meet the box at its surfaces (adjustable length 0..120 as 0..120 N). Net arrow floats overhead (0,0.7,0). Scale plate on a low post on the -x side.

INTERACTION: 2 sliders set left/right force; Go shows net arrow and animates box slide when net ≠ 0; Reset re-centers.

LAYERS: box; arrows pair; net arrow; scale.

NAMED NODES: Box, LeftArrow, RightArrow, NetArrow, ScalePlate, Mat. 5-8k tris.
